subject.title: [Feature]: Expose Discord slash interaction response controls to plugin commands

question: Should Discord interaction response controls for plugin commands be exposed as a generic plugin-command responder capability or as a Discord-specific `ctx.discord.respond` surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent shape changes a public Plugin SDK and channel contract; repository policy prefers narrow documented SDK seams and warns against channel-specific escape hatches unless maintainers intentionally choose them.

options.title: Design a generic command responder
options.body: Add an additive `ctx.respond`-style command capability with Discord support first, tests for existing returned-payload compatibility, and docs/API baseline updates.

options.title: Add Discord-specific `ctx.discord.respond`
options.body: Expose only Discord interaction primitives now, accepting a channel-specific SDK seam that may need future generalization if other channels need mixed-visibility command responses.

options.title: Defer the SDK surface
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until maintainers have a broader plugin-command response API plan across channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Design a generic command responder
recommendation.body: Add an additive `ctx.respond`-style command capability with Discord support first, tests for existing returned-payload compatibility, and docs/API baseline updates.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current trail for Plugin SDK boundary and Discord interactive API shape decisions points to steipete via the original command API committer metadata and plugin-boundary refactor history.
